comment: src/Z.cpp:118-126 is the whole of the processing: maxPoly is called, which sets the output channel counts, and the channel loop that follows has an empty body. Every one of the 17 knobs, 11 jacks and 8 outputs on the panel is therefore dead, and each gets a line saying so rather than falling back on the maker's tooltips, which describe the module the maker intends to write. No family is set anywhere, because nothing carries any meaning. The panel lettering is drawn at run time by the plugin's own label widget rather than being in the SVG, from the table at src/Z.cpp:151-165: A1M, A3M, RESM, A2M, A4M, A6M, P, Q, PLFO, QLFO, FLFO, WLFO, HP, FRQ, RES, A2, A4, A6, GATE, A, R, EMOD, A1, A3, CV, SUS, ENV1, ENV2, ENV1, ENV2, PA, QA, PB, QB, PC and QC. A second row of six labels reading TEST is in the table but is not placed, because its control entries are -1.
